label: prf:mass-identity-exists
title: Proof of existence of the inertial mass identity
html:
Proof. Proof of existence of the inertial mass identity

Each component of the composition is a morphism in \mathbf{C}:

  1. \Delta \colon A \to A \otimes A is part of the Frobenius--Hopf structure on A.
  2. \int_A \otimes \mathrm{id} \colon A \otimes A \to \mathbf{1} \otimes A \cong A is a morphism by tensor functoriality and the existence of \int_A.
  3. \mathrm{tr} \colon \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A) \to R exists via the rigid dual structure (rigid monoidal category).
  4. The norm \lVert \cdot \rVert on R induced by the Frobenius pairing is defined on every element of R.

The composition therefore produces an element of R for every cycle \varrho.
